items.question: What is the monthly storage fee under the Kestrel storage agreement?
items.answer: The monthly storage fee under the Kestrel storage agreement is EUR 4,600. This is stated in Amendment No. 1 to the Kestrel storage agreement, which replaces the original monthly storage fee of EUR 4,000 [2].

evidence.quote: Client shall pay a monthly storage fee of EUR 4,600, invoiced on the first business day of each month.
evidence.document_title: Amendment No. 1 to the Kestrel storage agreement

items.question: How much notice is needed to terminate the Kestrel storage agreement?
items.answer:
The Kestrel storage agreement specifies that either party may terminate the agreement with sixty (60) days' written notice [1].

There is no mention of any amendment to this termination clause in the sources provided.

evidence.quote: Either party may terminate this Agreement on sixty (60) days' written notice.

items.question: When did Jonas Ekberg say the chiller alarm sounded?
items.answer:

The source states: "I recall that the temperature alarm sounded at about 02:40 on 18 June 2026. I am not sure of the exact minute." [1] However, this is a statement of what he recalls, not a direct quote of when he said the alarm sounded.

The documents in this matter do not answer that.

items.question: What did the shift supervisor say about the Voss-Lindqvist pallets?
